topic: The Barber Pole Effect: Optical Rotation in Sugar Solutions

sections.title: Prerequisite: The Polarized Filter Analogy
lecture_lines: Light oscillates in all directions like random ripples.
Polarizers act as slotted fences, restricting light planes.
Vertical fences block horizontal light, showing polarization.

sections.title: The Chirality of Sugar Molecules
lecture_lines: Chiral sugar molecules possess a specific handedness.
They act like spiral staircases for light.
Interaction twists the light's polarization plane.
animations: Show 3D models of two mirror-image sugar molecules [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/sugar.svg] #FFFFFF.
Rotate molecules to demonstrate non-superimposable nature #FFCC00.
Highlight chiral centers in both molecules using #FF0000.

sections.title: Mechanism: The Barber Pole Effect
lecture_lines: Different light wavelengths rotate at different rates.
White light fans out creating color gradients.
Deeper travel maps a candy-cane helical twist.
Increasing path length makes the twist distinct.
The effect resembles a rotating barber pole.
animations: Represent plane-polarized light as a rotating vector #FFFFFF using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/barberpole.svg].
Animate vector passing through a chiral sugar solution #00FFFF using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/sugar.svg].
Show vector undergoing gradual angular rotation #FFCC00.

sections.title: Quantitative Visualization: The Rotation Equation
lecture_lines: Rotation angle depends on concentration and length.
The formula relates angle to physical properties.
Graphs show linear growth of the twist.
animations: Display rotation formula [α] = α / (l * c) in #FFFFFF, placing the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/cuvette.svg] to represent the path length context.

sections.title: Real-World Application: The Saccharimeter
lecture_lines: Saccharimeters measure sugar purity in industry.
They observe rotation to find concentration.
Precision ensures recipes match desired sweetness.
